title: Function coverage for Restart Communications Option
purpose: Exercise the documented restart-communications diagnostics path using the explicitly documented data value that clears the event log.

messages.label: diagnostics request - restart communications option clear event log

expected_behavior: A compliant server that supports Diagnostics should process function 0x08 subfunction 0x0001 with data 0x0000 as the clear-event-log form of Restart Communications Option, or return an exception if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length field 0x0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
PDU order preserved as function 0x08, subfunction, data
Data value 0x0000 follows the documented Restart Communications Option variant
issue_safety_notes: PK-only valid request; uses a documented control path but does not include malformed, oversized, or exploit-specific content.
